## Required Packages
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
packages <- c("R.oo", "jsonlite")
install_if_missing <- function(p) {
  if (!require(p, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(p)
    library(p, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}
invisible(sapply(packages, install_if_missing))
